'''The Stranglewood''' is a dangerous forest located south of [[Mount Quidamortem]], first visited during [[Desert Treasure II]]. The forest's fauna and flora have been infected by a parasitic organism known as [[The Strangler]]. 

Players are susceptible to infection from the [[Strangled]] in the area until the Stranglewood section of [[Desert Treasure II]] is completed. Players come to learn that the parasite is actually more of a plant unintentionally created by the [[Old Ones]] when they attempted to learn soul transference. 

==Transportation==
* The [[ring of shadows]] awarded on completion of Desert Treasure II teleports players directly to the Stranglewood Temple entrance. Players must first use the [[strangled tablet]] on it, which is obtained as a 1 in 25 drop from [[Vardorvis]].
* [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|bls}} brings players a short run west to the [[Rowboat (Great Kourend)|rowboat]], which can be boarded to reach the north-eastern coast of the Stranglewood.
* In [[Leagues]], the [[League Navigator]] at [[Quetzacalli Gorge]] can take players directly to and from the Stranglewood.

==Points of interest==

=== Ritual site ===
The ritual site is home to [[Vardorvis]], first fought during Desert Treasure II. He can be fought again after the quest, with the option of fighting an "awakened" version, which has an increased difficulty. 

=== Stranglewood mine ===
[[The Stranglewood mine]] is an area with three [[iron rocks]] in a triangle formation and one [[Runite rocks|runite rock]]. Players should be aware that, while uncommon, it is still possible for Strangled to reach the mine.

An unusable cave can be entered into south of the mine. Doing so will result in a chatbox message saying "You crawl into the dark and dreary tunnel..." and then "You get lost and somehow end up coming straight back out."

On the west side of the mine is a [[Stone chest (The Stranglewood mine)|stone chest]] which can be picklocked. Doing so will trigger a trap that teleports players to a random area in Zeah. The locations players are teleported to cannot be escaped from without the use of teleportation. The chest can only be opened once; the player will refuse to open it a second time.

==Trivia==
* Prior to [[9 August]] [[2023]], the music track [[The Old Ones]] (originally heard in [[The Garden of Death]]) played within the Stranglewood. With the update, the song was replaced by [[Strangled (music track)|Strangled]]. The Old Ones still plays within the dungeons inside the Stranglewood, such as the temple where you fight Kasonde Shaw.
* When using an [[oculus orb]] in the Stranglewood mine, players can spot another branch of [[The Sheared Ram]] pub to the east.
* A cave can be peeked into, causing a small spider to jump out and hit the player for 3 damage.
